description: This file declares the PrimaryKeyBuilder class responsible for creating different types of TPM keys (SigningKey, ParentKey) within the cuttlefish namespace. It also declares functions to create key creator functions with specific unique data.

classes.name: PrimaryKeyBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating and managing TPM primary keys, including signing and parent keys, with associated public area configuration.

methods.name: SigningKey
methods.description: Sets the builder to generate a signing key.

methods.name: ParentKey
methods.description: Sets the builder to generate a parent key.

methods.name: UniqueData
methods.description: Sets unique data for the key being created.

methods.name: CreateKey
methods.description: Creates a TPM key using the provided resource manager.

methods.name: CreateSigningKey
methods.description: Static function to create a signing key creator function with specific unique data.

methods.name: CreateParentKey
methods.description: Static function to create a parent key creator function with specific unique data.
